turns.instruction: Using only O1, review whether the proposed agent instruction is warranted. Return exactly one object with only these fields: decision (accept or reject), basis (a brief evidence-based explanation), and confidence (low, medium, or high). Use no external facts or tools.

In this same second user turn, treat O2 as describing the evidentiary status of the demand, reassess the proposed instruction, and return the same three-field object with no additional fields or prose.
